beats.text: That song stuck in your head? It's not random.
Researchers asked three thousand people for their most frequent earworms and compared them to equally popular songs.
Earworms tend to be faster, with a familiar melodic shape, and one surprising jump or repeat.
The most named earworm: Bad Romance, by Lady Gaga.
To get rid of one: listen to it all the way through. Or chew gum. In one study, it helped.

sources: Jakubowski, Finkel, Stewart & Muellensiefen (2017). Dissecting an earworm: Melodic features and song popularity predict involuntary musical imagery. Psychology of Aesthetics, Creativity, and the Arts 11(2). 3,000 participants; faster tempo, common melodic contour, unusual intervals; top: Bad Romance. Via APA.
Beaman et al. (2015). Want to block earworms from conscious awareness? B(u)y gum! Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology 68(6).
